body:
I'm actually looking for a team because my ancient team, Tsuribashi has just disbanded.

I live in France. (GTM+1)
In the week i can play from 8 PM to 10 PM. (GTM+1)
The week end i can play from 8 AM to 11 PM. (GTM+1)
I have skype, TeamSpeak and mumble.

Position ans skills:
I mainly play at the position of skybridger/frontliner
I'm pretty good at bow.
I can sneak unsneak bridge.
